info.title: Rev-PasswordManager API
info.description: API for Secure Password Manager Application

tags.name: Authentication
tags.description: Endpoints for login, registration, and session management

tags.name: Vault
tags.description: Endpoints for managing passwords, notes, and secure data

get.summary: Fetch a specific vault entry by its ID

delete.summary: Move a specific entry to the trash

put.summary: Toggle the favorite status of an entry
Toggle whether an entry requires master password to view
Set or update the password hint

get.summary: Retrieve all entries in the user's vault

post.summary: Create a new entry in the user's vault
Request access to view a highly sensitive vault entry
Restore a specific entry from the trash to the main vault
Restore all entries currently in the trash bin
Reveal plain text password for a specific entry
Move multiple vault entries to the trash
Validate security question answers during recovery
Verify OTP code during 2FA login sequence
Re-authenticate master password for sensitive actions
Verify captcha token
Configure a duress password for emergency data wiping
Send OTP code to user's email
Reset the master password using security questions
Resend OTP code to user's email
Register a new user account
Refresh an expired JWT session token
Logout user and invalidate token
Authenticate user and return JWT token
Initiate account recovery via email link
Login using a duress password (wipes local vault data)
Verify and enable 2FA
Initialize 2FA setup (get QR code)
Regenerate backup recovery codes
Disable 2FA

get.summary: List all entries currently in the trash
Get the total count of items in the trash
Search for vault entries via various filters
Filter vault entries by category or folder
View historic snapshots of an entry's lifecycle
Check if current JWT token is active and valid
Get security questions for a given username
Retrieve password hint for given username

delete.summary: Irreversibly delete a specific vault entry
Irreversibly delete all items inside the trash

title.description: The title or name of the entry

username.description: The username or email for the account

categoryId.description: Optional ID of a Category to assign this entry to

folderId.description: Optional ID of a Folder to place this entry inside

isFavorite.description: Boolean flag to mark entry as a favorite

isHighlySensitive.description: Boolean flag indicating if the entry is highly sensitive (requires re-prompt of master password)

VaultEntryRequest.description: Request object for creating or updating a vault entry

masterPassword.description: The user's master password to prove identity

otpToken.description: Optional 2FA OTP token if the user has 2FA enabled

SensitiveAccessRequest.description: Request object for accessing a highly sensitive vault entry

securityAnswers.description: Array of 3 correctly answered security questions

newMasterPassword.description: The new master password to set

RecoveryRequest.description: Request object for recovering a master password via security questions

username.description: User's chosen display name or login handle

masterPassword.description: The highly secure master password for the vault

securityQuestions.description: Array of 3 security questions/answers for account recovery

passwordHint.description: Optional hint to remember the master password

RegistrationRequest.description: Request object for registering a new user

LoginRequest.description: Request object for authenticating a user
